title: Luscious Italian Egg Yolks Vitello Tonnato
description: Buttery, crisp, and festive Italian dish featuring egg yolks, robata-grill, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a special occasion meal.

ingredients.name: veal
ingredients.amount: 1 pound, boneless and sliced into 1/4-inch thick pieces

instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat.
Season the sliced veal with salt and black pepper.
Grill the veal slices for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.
Transfer the grilled veal to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, mix the capers, olive oil, anchovy paste, garlic, and lemon juice in a bowl.
Add the egg yolks to the bowl and mix until smooth.
Add the softened butter to the bowl and mix until fully incorporated.
Stir in the chopped parsley and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
To serve, slice the grilled veal into thin strips and arrange on plates.
Drizzle the egg yolk sauce over the veal and top with a dollop of sour cream.
